data.transcript:
Agent: Good morning, Aangan Studio.
Caller: Hi, I'm Priya. I got your number from a friend, Shruti Joshi. She had her flat done by you in Aundh.
Agent: Thank you for calling, Priya. What are you looking to do?
Caller: We have a 3BHK in Kothrud, Dahanukar Colony. We want to redo the whole thing: kitchen, living room, both bedrooms.
Agent: How big is the apartment, in carpet area?
Caller: About 1,400 sq ft carpet.
Agent: So about fourteen hundred square feet carpet, is that right?
Caller: Yes.
Agent: And when would you need the project complete?
Caller: By March. We're in no rush.
Agent: Are you the owner?
Caller: Yes, myself and my husband. He knows we're calling.
Agent: May I take your email?
Caller: priya.test@example.com
Agent: That's p-r-i-y-a dot t-e-s-t at example dot com?
Caller: Yes.
Agent: Thank you, I've noted your details and passed them to our team.
data.summary: Priya, referred by Shruti Joshi, wants a full redesign of a 3BHK in Kothrud (about 1,400 sq ft carpet), complete by March. Owner with husband. Email given.
